source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 5 词表(p49-60 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、音乐主题(虚拟合唱团/音乐类型/街头艺人/音乐的力量/乐器)、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: My brother plays the guitar in a local rock band.
words.example_cn: 我哥哥在一支本地摇滚乐队里弹吉他。

words.example_en: The young singers will perform on stage at the music festival.
words.example_cn: 这些年轻歌手将在音乐节上登台表演。

words.example_en: Their live performance moved everyone in the hall.
words.example_cn: 他们的现场演出感动了大厅里的每一个人。

words.example_en: A street performer was playing the violin for the crowd.
words.example_cn: 一位街头艺人正为人群拉小提琴。

words.example_en: Beethoven is one of the greatest composers in history.
words.example_cn: 贝多芬是历史上最伟大的作曲家之一。

words.example_en: He wrote his first composition when he was only nine.
words.example_cn: 他九岁时就写出了自己的第一部作品。

words.meaning_cn: (乐队、合唱团的)指挥;(公交车的)售票员
words.example_en: The conductor raised his hands and the music began.
words.example_cn: 指挥举起双手,音乐随即响起。

words.example_en: She fell in love with classical music while singing in the choir.
words.example_cn: 她在合唱团唱歌时爱上了古典音乐。

words.example_en: The band recorded their new album in a small studio.
words.example_cn: 这支乐队在一间小录音棚里录制了他们的新专辑。

words.example_en: You do not even need a studio to join a virtual choir.
words.example_cn: 加入虚拟合唱团你甚至不需要录音棚。

words.example_en: He felt nervous and excited when invited to perform on the stage.
words.example_cn: 被邀请登台表演时,他既紧张又兴奋。

words.example_en: Those who think they have no musical talent can still help.
words.example_cn: 那些觉得自己没有音乐天赋的人仍然可以帮忙。

words.meaning_cn: 原创的;最初的;原件;原作
words.example_en: His original compositions became popular among many choirs.
words.example_cn: 他的原创作品在许多合唱团中流行起来。

words.example_en: A virtual choir helps connect ordinary people together.
words.example_cn: 虚拟合唱团帮助把普通人联结在一起。

words.example_en: Imagine having the opportunity to sing with hundreds of others.
words.example_cn: 想象一下,你有机会和数百人一起歌唱。

words.example_en: A virtual choir enables shy people to add their voices to others.
words.example_cn: 虚拟合唱团使害羞的人也能加入自己的歌声。

words.example_en: The virtual choir has proved to be a positive influence on many lives.
words.example_cn: 虚拟合唱团已被证明对许多人的生活有积极影响。

words.example_en: Since then, the virtual choir has become a worldwide phenomenon.
words.example_cn: 从那以后,虚拟合唱团成了一种全球现象。

words.example_en: The CD contains various styles of music from around the world.
words.example_cn: 这张光盘收录了来自世界各地的各种风格的音乐。

words.example_en: In a virtual choir, singers record themselves alone at home.
words.example_cn: 在虚拟合唱团里,歌手们独自在家录下自己。

words.example_en: My favourite singer just won a music award.
words.example_cn: 我最喜欢的歌手刚刚赢得了一个音乐奖。

words.example_en: Music has had a great impact on my life.
words.example_cn: 音乐对我的生活产生了巨大的影响。

words.example_en: Two years ago I was told I had a serious disease.
words.example_cn: 两年前我被告知患上了一种严重的疾病。

words.meaning_cn: 治愈;治疗;解决;药物;办法
words.example_en: She found that making music was a cure for her sadness.
words.example_cn: 她发现创作音乐是治愈她悲伤的良方。

words.example_en: During the medical treatment, the doctor had her listen to music.
words.example_cn: 在治疗过程中,医生让她听音乐。

words.example_en: Music gave me strength and brought me relief.
words.example_cn: 音乐给了我力量,也带给我宽慰。

words.example_en: Music gave me hope and a sense of satisfaction.
words.example_cn: 音乐给了我希望和一种满足感。

words.example_en: Sad love songs often touch the souls of those who listen.
words.example_cn: 悲伤的情歌常常打动听者的心灵。

words.example_en: I like to listen to dance music because it gives me energy.
words.example_cn: 我喜欢听舞曲,因为它给我能量。

words.example_en: Through music he felt the beauty he had known in his previous days.
words.example_cn: 透过音乐,他感受到了往日所熟悉的美。

words.example_en: Even affected by gradual blindness, Henry kept writing music.
words.example_cn: 即使受逐渐失明的影响,亨利仍坚持作曲。

words.example_en: He was still capable of writing beautiful compositions.
words.example_cn: 他仍然能够创作出优美的作品。

words.example_en: Once unemployed, the singer finally got the chance to record a song.
words.example_cn: 曾经失业的这位歌手终于有了录歌的机会。

words.example_en: Some volunteers will set up the equipment before the show.
words.example_cn: 一些志愿者会在演出前架设好设备。

words.example_en: The aim of this festival is to bring people together through music.
words.example_cn: 这个音乐节的目的是通过音乐把人们聚到一起。

words.example_en: In addition to singing, you could help sell festival tickets.
words.example_cn: 除了唱歌,你还可以帮忙卖音乐节门票。

words.example_en: Moreover, music gave me hope during those hard times.
words.example_cn: 此外,在那些艰难的日子里音乐给了我希望。

words.example_en: People sing with one voice and thus make the world better.
words.example_cn: 人们用同一个声音歌唱,从而让世界变得更美好。

words.meaning_cn: 以某种方式;不知怎么地
words.example_en: I hope you will somehow begin to treasure music in your life.
words.example_cn: 我希望你能以某种方式开始珍视生活中的音乐。

words.example_en: Nowadays millions of performances are uploaded online every day.
words.example_cn: 如今每天都有数百万场演出被上传到网上。

words.example_en: Altogether, more than two thousand young people joined the choir.
words.example_cn: 总共有两千多名年轻人加入了这个合唱团。

words.example_en: Can I assume that the aim of the festival is to raise money?
words.example_cn: 我可以认为这个音乐节的目的是筹款吗?

words.example_en: Moved by his romantic words, she accepted his gift.
words.example_cn: 被他浪漫的话语打动,她接受了他的礼物。

words.example_en: Music was the rock I leant on to get through hard times.
words.example_cn: 音乐是我赖以度过艰难时光的依靠。

words.example_en: Encouraged by the positive reaction of the audience, she kept playing.
words.example_cn: 受到观众积极反应的鼓舞,她坚持演奏下去。

words.example_en: My parents wanted me to learn to play the piano at the age of six.
words.example_cn: 父母想让我在六岁时学习弹钢琴。

words.example_en: When I listen to hip-hop, I just have to move.
words.example_cn: 我一听嘻哈音乐就忍不住想动起来。

words.example_en: The pipa is a traditional Chinese stringed instrument.
words.example_cn: 琵琶是一种传统的中国弦乐器。
